desc:
🌍 In This World... every round is a new rule.

Inspired by the viral "in this world..." and "in this town..." Roblox story videos. Now you're IN one.

📖 STORY MODE drops TODAY 5PM Central! The Moon Peeks: Mom isn't Mom at night... and the Moon is watching. Play solo or with up to 3 friends.

🔦 The lights go out and something walks the streets. Keep the beacon lit.
🌙 A giant face opens its eyes in the sky. Don't move.
🎯 One player has a 0 over their head... and everyone is coming for them.
🌋 Lava at noon. Gravity quits. One chair too few.

⚡ Every world gets worse halfway through. HARD ROUNDS pay double.

⭐ Favorite + 🔔 Notify so you're in first.

👥 Join the In This World Official group!
🐞 BETA: use the bug button to tell us what you think.
